scope: Already exposed inner fit/stop only; no Fold 1/2, outer_eval, visual feature extraction or formal report edit

arm_definitions.T0: Fit-only convex global temperature on frozen oos_pre probabilities
arm_definitions.D0: Fit-only regularized Dirichlet calibration softmax(W log(p)+b), 20 raw parameters; identity-centred L2, not ODIR
arm_definitions.M0: Same 18D evidence and 2401-parameter head; T=softplus(score+log(expm1(1-1e-6)))+1e-6; final four-class NLL; not a full AdaTS reproduction
arm_definitions.P0: Same target head and verification interval as A4; train final clipped four-class NLL
arm_definitions.P1: Same target head and interval as A4; train raw unweighted BCE; exact A4 training reproduction required

head.initialization: Identical trainable state for M0/P0/P1 and original A4 within each seed

global_temperature.solver: Convex endpoint derivative tests, then 80 bisection steps; any boundary optimum reported

dirichlet.selection: Fixed regularization; no stop-set hyperparameter tuning

checkpoint_criterion: Minimum unweighted stopping four-class NLL; earliest epoch on ties; epoch 0 not eligible, matching original A4
training_diagnostics: Per train-mode mini-batch counts, hard-interval saturation, target saturation, exact-zero score gradients, target zero gradients, parameter data-gradient norm; no STE or joint loss
promotion_policy: No automatic promotion or outer access. Descriptive three-seed comparison only, with recall and both intrusion rates alongside NLL; preserve original gate results unchanged.
theory_boundary: Tests whether conditional-risk projection evidence exceeds calibration and whether raw proper supervision avoids hard-clipping plateaus; no new visual network, generic theorem or finite-sample superiority claim
